content.value: A 12 cm wide and 18 cm high vertical hot surface in $3 0 \textdegree C$ air is to be cooled by a heat sink with equally spaced fins of rectangular profile. The fins are 0.1 cm thick and 18 cm long in the vertical direction and have a height of 2.4 cm from the base. Determine the optimum fin spacing and the rate of heat transfer by natural convection from the heat sink if the base temperature is $8 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
